documents_page_description: Write notices, meeting minutes or any other document and download it as a PDF with the community's logo and name.
documents_draft_hint: What you write is saved on this device until you start a new document.
documents_header_title_description: Shown at the top of every page, under the community's name.
documents_header_title_too_long: The header can be up to {max} characters
documents_date_description: Shown at the top of every page, on the right.
documents_title_too_long: The title can be up to {max} characters
documents_link_hint: A web page or an email address.
documents_link_invalid: Enter a valid web page or email address
documents_image_failed: The image couldn't be opened. Use a JPG or PNG picture.
documents_draft_too_big: The document no longer fits on this device: reloading the page would lose the latest changes. Remove an image so it's saved again.
documents_generate_failed: The document couldn't be generated. Reload the page and try again.
documents_too_long: The document is too big. Remove some images or split it in two and try again.
documents_start_over_description: Everything you wrote in this document will be erased. This can't be undone.
documents_templates_manage_description: The ones the board saved. Whoever saved one, or an admin, can edit or delete it.
documents_templates_none: No saved templates yet. Write a document and save it as a template.
documents_template_load_failed: The template couldn't be opened. Try again.
documents_template_save_description: The whole board will find it in Templates, with this document's header, title and text.
documents_template_name_hint: How it shows up in the templates menu.
documents_template_description_hint: Optional: what it's for, in one line.
documents_template_name_too_long: The name can be up to {max} characters
documents_template_description_too_long: The description can be up to {max} characters
documents_template_too_big: The document is too big to save as a template. Remove or shrink an image.
documents_template_name_taken: There's already a template with that name
documents_template_edit_description: Only the name and the description change. To change the document, save a new one as a template and delete this one.
documents_template_delete_description: It disappears from Templates for the whole board. Documents already made with it don't change. This can't be undone.
documents_template_notice_description: Maintenance work, service outages or any announcement.
documents_template_notice_content:
Dear residents, Please note that the HOA board will carry out **[type of work: painting, waterproofing, pump repair…]** in **[area]**. While the work lasts, there will be ++[water outages / the area will be closed / limited vehicle access]++. ## Schedule | Day | Time | What will be done | | :--- | :---: | :--- | | [day and date] | [time] to [time] | [activity] | | [day and date] | [time] to [time] | [activity] | > **Important:** [On [day] there will be no water from [time] to [time]. We recommend storing water the night before.] ## What you need to know - **Access:** [the area will be closed / the area can be used with care]. - **Vehicles:** please [don't park in / move your vehicles out of] [place] before [time]. - **Children and pets:** keep them away from the work area. - [Any other instruction, if needed.] - If the work runs late, we'll let you know through this channel. *[Optional: add a photo or a map of the area with the image button.]* ## Questions and reports For any questions, contact **[name]**, of the HOA board, at [phone] or [email]. Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely
The HOA board
documents_template_meeting_call_descript: Date, place, agenda and quorum of a residents' meeting.
documents_template_meeting_call_content:
Under [the community bylaws / the applicable article], the HOA board invites all owners and residents to the [regular / special] meeting, to be held as follows:

| Date | First call | Second call | Place | | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | [day and date] | [time] | [time] | [place] | ## Agenda 1. Attendance and quorum check. 2. Reading and, if appropriate, approval of the minutes of the previous meeting. 3. Board report. 4. Treasury report: - Income and expenses for the period. - Houses with outstanding fees. 5. [Topic] 6. Other business. ### Quorum

On first call, the meeting can start with [percentage] of the houses present. If that isn't reached, it will be held on second call with [the houses present / the percentage set by the bylaws].

> **Can't attend?** You can name a representative with a signed proxy letter; ask the HOA board for the form. Each representative can carry ++up to [number] proxies++. Your participation matters for the decisions of our community.

Sincerely
The HOA board

Name and signature |

Dear residents, This is a reminder that the maintenance fee for **[month]** is due on ==**[due date]**==. Paying on time lets us cover [security, cleaning, water for the common areas and the upkeep of the community]. ## Amounts | Item | Amount | | :--- | ---: | | Monthly fee | [amount] | | Late fee after the [day] | [amount] | | **Total with late fee** | **[amount]** | ## How to pay ### Bank transfer - **Bank:** [bank] - **Account holder:** [name] - **Account number:** [number] - **Routing number:** [number] - **Reference:** ++your house number++ (for example, A12) ### Cash With [person], on [days] from [time] to [time], at [place]. documents_template_amenity_rules_descrip: Hours, bookings, rules of use and penalties for the common areas.
documents_template_amenity_rules_content:
These rules set out how the community's common areas are used, so every resident can enjoy them safely and in good order. They were approved at the meeting of [date].

# General provisions 1. The common areas are for residents and their guests only. 2. Each house is responsible for its guests and for any damage they cause. 3. Houses more than [number] months behind on fees ++can't book++ common areas. # Hours | Area | Monday to Friday | Weekends | Booking required | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | | [Pool] | [time] to [time] | [time] to [time] | No | | [Party room] | [time] to [time] | [time] to [time] | Yes | | [Terrace] | [time] to [time] | [time] to [time] | Yes | # Bookings ## How to book 1. Ask the HOA board for the date at least [number] days ahead. 2. Pay the fee of [amount], if the area has one. 3. You'll get a confirmation with the booked date. ## Cancellations

If you cancel more than [number] days ahead, you'll get back [all / the percentage] of the fee. With less notice, there's no refund.

# Rules of use ## [Pool] - Children under [age] must be with an adult. - Glass containers ++are not allowed++. - Shower before going in. ## [Party room] - Music must end by [time]. - The room is handed back clean and in the same condition it was received. - Any damage is charged to the house that booked it. # Penalties > Breaking these rules is penalized as follows: > > 1. **First time:** a written warning. > 2. **Second time:** a fine of [amount]. > 3. **Third time:** no use of the common areas for [period].

Sincerely
The HOA board
documents_ai_description: If you use ChatGPT, Gemini or another assistant, this text tells it how to write the document so it looks right in the PDF.
documents_ai_step_describe: Paste it in the chat and replace what's in brackets with what you want to say.
documents_ai_step_paste: Copy the reply and paste it in Content. The title goes in its own field.
documents_ai_copy_failed_description: Select the text and copy it manually
documents_ai_prompt:
I need to write a document for the residents of {residential}. It comes from the HOA board.

What I want to say: [describe the document here: a notice, meeting minutes, a reminder… what happened or what's going to happen, with dates, amounts and decisions]

Instructions:
- Write in English, in a formal, clear and friendly tone.
- Reply with the document's text only, with no introduction or closing comments, and don't put it inside a code block.
- Don't write the document's title, its date or the community's name: they're already in the header.
- Format it only with headings (up to four levels), paragraphs, bulleted or numbered lists, bold, italics, strikethrough, quotes, links and simple tables (a few columns, only text in each cell).
- Don't use divider lines, emojis or images: the document can't show them.
- If a detail is missing (a date, an amount, a name), leave it in brackets, like [date], to fill in later.
